title: How to Navigate Grandma’s Thanksgiving Dinner Without Spiking Your Post-Meal Glucose—Especially If You’re Newly Diagnosed With Prediabetes at 58
description: A step-by-step, plate-by-plate guide to making real-time food swaps, timing insulin or meds, and using fiber-first sequencing to blunt glucose spikes during multigenerational holiday meals.
